'''Taiiku Okazaki''' (Japanese: '''岡崎体育''' ''Okazaki Taiiku'' or ''Okazaki Physical Education'') is a Japanese musician who has written and sung various songs for {{aniseries|PTS}} and [[Pokémon movies]], starting in {{aniseries|SM}}. His real name is '''Akitoshi Oka''' (Japanese: '''岡亮聡''' ''Oka Akitoshi'').

==Biography==
Okazaki was born on July 3, 1989 in {{wp|Nishinomiya}}, {{wp|Hyōgo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He began his musical career in 2012, and made his official debut with the album ''BASIN TECHNO'' under {{wp|Sony Music Entertainment Japan|SME Records}} in 2016.
